read_against: the predeclared_gate block inside arc3-interior-v1/q38-flashnext-manifest.json, written before the run

MECHANISM_PASSES_DECISIVELY.sanity_check: interior_mask_cells > 0 required on a majority of games; measured 25 of 25, total 4,644 masked cells
MECHANISM_PASSES_DECISIVELY.what_this_establishes: The defect is REAL on the model we ship, not only in the 27B-era corpus. The offline learner realized 8.6% when simulated over that corpus; live on Flash-Next it realizes 12.45%, higher than predicted. On roughly one graded transition in eight the harness was telling the model the board changed when the play area had not moved.

NO_DISPLACEMENT.actions_per_game: 118.3 against the control's 109.2, i.e. UP, not down.
NO_DISPLACEMENT.why_it_matters: Max-harness lost levels by displacing play: 109.2 to 66.8 to 35.8 actions per game as machinery was added. This arm adds one host-computed observation field and no model-facing machinery, and the action budget is intact. The two results together separate the two failure modes cleanly.

LEVELS_ARE_UNDECIDED_AND_I_AM_NOT_MOVING.gate_text_verbatim: UNDECIDED_BY_BENCH: 31 to 46 levels. Report the counters, ship nothing, keep ONEWAVE.
LEVELS_ARE_UNDECIDED_AND_I_AM_NOT_MOVING.position: 42 is inside the Flash-Next family (40 to 47) and inside the 12.5-level MDE, so it is a TIE on levels, not a regression. Rule 15(c) does not bar it. But the gate I wrote before the run says ship nothing in this band, and I am not going to reinterpret my own gate after seeing a number I like.
LEVELS_ARE_UNDECIDED_AND_I_AM_NOT_MOVING.the_conflict_I_am_flagging_rather_than_r: The same gate's own note says 'the 47-level bar cannot resolve this arm on levels alone. That is why the mechanism counter, not the level count, is the verdict.' That clause and the UNDECIDED clause contradict each other. I wrote both, before the run, and did not notice. Separately, CLAUDE.md rule 15(b) says a TIE with a verified mechanism fix belongs in the rotation rather than in a drawer, and this is exactly that case.
LEVELS_ARE_UNDECIDED_AND_I_AM_NOT_MOVING.who_decides: Promotion into a scored slot is the owner's decision. Everything needed to promote is prepared; nothing has been promoted.

SUPPORTING_BUT_NOT_DECISIVE.zeros: 2, against 5 on GG8, 8 on the sampling arm and 3 to 5 across the family. Best breadth this project has measured.
SUPPORTING_BUT_NOT_DECISIVE.caution: That comparison is against a REJECTED arm, not against ONEWAVE, because ONEWAVE's 46-level run predates this bench corpus. It is suggestive and it is not the control.
